day1_insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so stormwater runoff isn't a factor right now. The model's main signals right now: high tide timing is lowering risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; no rain has fallen, so nothing is washing off the land into the surf; and high tide level is lowering risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls. The most recent sample, 7 days ago, was excellent at 10 MPN/100mL. It's a naturally clean, well-flushed open-coast beach (unsafe only ~3% of the time), so outside of storms it's reliably safe.
